panels.title: DICOMs in completed S3 uploads (last 1h)
panels.description: Sum of the pre-transfer dicoms inventory on upload_completed events. Counts .dcm/.DCM files, including files already present at the destination. Repeated uploads of a changed session can count the same DICOM again. Missing or invalid numeric fields are excluded. This is not an XNAT delivery count.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({namespace="xnat-ingest",component="s3-uploader"} | json | event="upload_completed" | unwrap dicoms | __error__="" [1h])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Files in completed S3 uploads (last 1h)
panels.description: Sum of the pre-transfer files inventory on upload_completed events, including DICOMs, one __MANIFEST__.json per resource, and other staged metadata. This is not the number of newly written S3 objects. Repeated uploads can count the same file again; missing or invalid numeric fields are excluded.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({namespace="xnat-ingest",component="s3-uploader"} | json | event="upload_completed" | unwrap files | __error__="" [1h])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Completed S3 uploads (last 1h)
panels.description: Count of upload_completed events: the S3 copy command returned success. A changed session can complete more than once. This counts transfer attempts, not unique sessions or confirmed XNAT delivery.

panels.title: Upload failures (last 1h)
panels.description: Count of upload_failed events from the transfer to the staging bucket. Zero means no matching failures were recorded; it does not prove that uploads ran or that log delivery is healthy.

panels.title: Invalid sessions (last 1h)
panels.description: Count of Invalid IDs found ERROR messages from xnat-ingest assign. These indicate missing or invalid session identifiers. Repeated attempts can count the same session again. Inspect the message and staged data before correcting identifiers and retrying.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({namespace="xnat-ingest",component="assign"} | json | level="ERROR" | message =~ "^Invalid IDs found.*" [1h])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Assign cycles with errors (last 1h)
panels.description: Each xnat-ingest assign cycle that ended with at least one error logs a 'Staging completed with N errors' summary. Counting that summary line gives one tick per failed cycle, regardless of how many sessions were rejected within it. The regex uses (?s) so `.` matches the newlines that follow the colon in the multi-line summary.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({namespace="xnat-ingest",component="assign"} | json | message =~ "(?s)^Staging completed with.*" [1h])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Edge sites with assign logs (last 1h)
panels.description: Distinct non-management cluster labels on assign logs in the last hour. Management reclaimers can carry the served edge label, so their activity is excluded. This measures recent assign log delivery, not pod health or successful delivery to XNAT.

panels.title: Recent invalid sessions (last 1h)
panels.description: Invalid session identifier messages from assign. Inspect the stated errors and the staged files before correcting identifiers and retrying. A session can appear more than once after repeated attempts.

targets.expr: {namespace="xnat-ingest",component="assign"} | json | level="ERROR" | message =~ "^Invalid IDs found.*" | line_format "{{.cluster}} — {{.message}}"

panels.title: Pipeline events per minute (by event type)
panels.description: Structured s3-uploader events only. Lines without an event field are excluded so they do not create an unnamed series.

panels.title: Per-edge upload throughput (events/min)
panels.description: Count of upload_completed events per minute, grouped by edge cluster. Counts completed S3 transfer attempts, not unique sessions or XNAT delivery.

panels.title: Failure rate (upload_failed / upload_started)
panels.description: Ratio of upload_failed to upload_started events in each 15-minute window. Reports zero when starts exist without failures; leaves a gap when there are no starts. A transfer can start and finish in different windows, so this is an event ratio, not a matched-attempt failure probability.

targets.expr: (sum by (cluster) (count_over_time({namespace="xnat-ingest",component="s3-uploader"} | json | event="upload_failed" [15m])) or (0 * sum by (cluster) (count_over_time({namespace="xnat-ingest",component="s3-uploader"} | json | event="upload_started" [15m])))) / (sum by (cluster) (count_over_time({namespace="xnat-ingest",component="s3-uploader"} | json | event="upload_started" [15m])) > 0)

panels.title: Recent pipeline events (last 30 min)
panels.description: Structured edge pipeline events over the last 30 minutes when a relative dashboard range is selected. The Session Timeline also includes management upload and reclaim logs.

targets.expr: {namespace="xnat-ingest"} | json | event != "" | line_format "[{{.cluster}}/{{.component}}] event={{.event}}{{if .session}} session={{.session}}{{end}}{{if .duration_s}} duration={{.duration_s}}s{{end}}{{if .files}} files={{.files}}{{end}}{{if .bytes}} bytes={{.bytes}}{{end}} — {{.message}}"
